milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the bookshelf structure (centered at spawn-relative [5, 1, 7]) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the bookshelf.' max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bookshelves.

Uses inventory_has to check for the flower_pot drop. When a potted_blue_orchid block is mined, it drops a flower_pot and a blue_orchid as separate items — the combined block 'potted_blue_orchid' does NOT exist as an inventory item. Checking for flower_pot in inventory confirms the player successfully mined the potted block. The flower_pot is not in the starting inventory and cannot be obtained any other way in this scene.
